objective: I can practice washing hands all the way. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: At a bathroom or kitchen sink, before any new instruction, the learner washes their hands the way they normally would while a family member watches quietly without coaching, so both can see the learner's starting habits.
safetyNotes: Use only a sink, soap, and a towel for this lesson; ask a trusted adult before touching anything else in the kitchen.
materials: learner-local: a sink with running water

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u03-l01-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u03-l01-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u03-l01-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u03-l01-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Name one specific step you skipped in your very first wash today that you now do every time, and explain why that step matters.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u03-l01-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u03-l01-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u03-l01-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Step sequence: All five steps are present and completed in the modeled order. | Scrub thoroughness: Scrubbing covers the backs of hands, between fingers, and under nails for close to twenty seconds. | Baseline comparison: The learner names at least one specific step that was missing from their baseline wash. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u03-l01-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner teach the five-step sequence to a stuffed animal or another household member willing to listen, narrating each step out loud in order, to test whether they can explain the sequence and not just perform it themselves.

resources.title: washing hands all the way worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: At a bathroom or kitchen sink, before any new instruction, the learner washes their hands the way they normally would while a family member watches quietly without coaching, so both can see the learner's starting habits.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact washing hands all the way decision or action.
Model move 2: Before learning the five-step sequence, wash your hands the way you normally do, without any new instructions.

Model move 3: Now learn and practice the full five-step sequence at the sink: wet your hands, add soap, scrub every surface for twenty seconds (backs of hands, between fingers, under nails), rinse until the soap is gone, and dry with a clean towel.

Model check: Step sequence: All five steps are present and completed in the modeled order. | Scrub thoroughness: Scrubbing covers the backs of hands, between fingers, and under nails for close to twenty seconds. | Baseline comparison: The learner names at least one specific step that was missing from their baseline wash.

resources.title: washing hands all the way coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: At a bathroom or kitchen sink, before any new instruction, the learner washes their hands the way they normally would while a family member watches quietly without coaching, so both can see the learner's starting habits.
Coach direction: Before learning the five-step sequence, wash your hands the way you normally do, without any new instructions.
Learner prompt: List each thing you did, in order, when you washed your hands just now.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: washing hands all the way complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Now learn and practice the full five-step sequence at the sink: wet your hands, add soap, scrub every surface for twenty seconds (backs of hands, between fingers, under nails), rinse until the soap is gone, and dry with a clean towel.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I wet my hands with running water before adding soap.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I scrubbed the backs of my hands, between my fingers, and under my nails, not just my palms.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I scrubbed for the full twenty seconds, timed by singing the alphabet song once through.
Response 4 (t2-p4): I dried my hands completely with a clean towel before touching anything else.
Equal-access rule: Use the fictional condition above and complete the same reasoning and evidence without private real-world details.

Reflection: Name one specific step you skipped in your very first wash today that you now do every time, and explain why that step matters.

Success checks: Step sequence: All five steps are present and completed in the modeled order. | Scrub thoroughness: Scrubbing covers the backs of hands, between fingers, and under nails for close to twenty seconds. | Baseline comparison: The learner names at least one specific step that was missing from their baseline wash.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: washing hands all the way supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g3-u03-l01-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g3-u03-l01-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional washing hands all the way condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Step sequence: All five steps are present and completed in the modeled order. | Scrub thoroughness: Scrubbing covers the backs of hands, between fingers, and under nails for close to twenty seconds. | Baseline comparison: The learner names at least one specific step that was missing from their baseline wash..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u03-l01-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.

tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
